disagreement_register.subject: P3R2-C-05 liquid-cooling conformance metrology: OLD killed at P4 G7 (67.4); NEW selected rank 3 + deep dive; BLIND independently rank 2.
disagreement_register.status: VERIFIED (deepened re-check of the pilot finding)
findings: Google contributed the Project Deschutes CDU to OCP and published the spec ('ocp-specification-deschutes-final-2025-09-05') and design collateral; seven suppliers named (Boyd, CoolerMaster, Delta, Envicool, Nidec, nVent, Vertiv) demoing at OCP Global Summit and SC25 — RE-VERIFIED by reopening the Google Cloud blog post of 2025-10-13 in full (C05-DIS-01).

Nidec's own release confirms a Deschutes-spec-compliant 2 MW-class, 80 PSI prototype CDU with IEEE-519 ULHD VFD, exhibited at SC25 (Nov 2025) — RE-VERIFIED by reopening (C05-DIS-02). Page date remains ambiguous (displayed 03/12/2025; URL news1203 and SC25 content imply 2025-12-03).
OCP spec PDF re-attempted this run: still HTTP 403 — remains EXISTENCE-ONLY via the hyperlink inside the opened Google post (C05-DIS-03).

Fresh search surfaced OCP's 'Liquid to Liquid CDU Test Methodology' performance-rating WHITE PAPER and the CDU sub-project page; both returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch (C05-DIS-04, C05-DIS-05). The negative claim ('no complete conformance program with reference hardware') therefore stays PARTIALLY VERIFIED at discovery level: a test-methodology white paper exists, which matches new06 D03's own narrow wording but was not confirmed by opening OCP pages.
new06's '8 named vendors': Google's own blog names seven; the eighth (Stulz) remains trade-press/discovery-level only (DCD page 403 in pilot; not re-attempted).
disagreement_register.adjudication: New06's factual predicate for the revival is substantively correct on opened primary evidence; old06's kill rested partly on a forecast (OCP/vendor labs closing the gap before 2030) not materialized as of the 2026 refresh and partly on strict gate construction. BLIND rank 2 and NEW rank 3 converge. Confidence: HIGH on Deschutes ecosystem facts; MODERATE on the OCP-vacuum negative claim; MODERATE-TO-HIGH that the old kill was factually wrong.

disagreement_register.subject: P3R2-D-10 coherent-beam-combining phase-control engine: OLD killed at P4 G7 despite its highest kill score (73.4); NEW selected rank 4 + deep dive; BLIND rank 14. Top-set membership flips between OLD (absent) and NEW (rank 4, deep-dived).
findings: JLWS OTAs were awarded 2026-07-09: Lockheed Martin (500 kW containerized JLWS; own release opened, D10-DIS-01) and nLIGHT ($44M initial / $627M ceiling; own release opened, D10-DIS-02). Combined ceiling reported at $847M (announcement coverage).

nLIGHT's release states initial ~150 kW prototypes scaling to 300-500 kW, operational demonstrations 'as early as 2028', and that nLIGHT will leverage 'proprietary coherent beam combination and atmospheric correction technology' within a 'vertically integrated manufacturing approach' — direct primary evidence that the awardee holds the phase-control layer IN-HOUSE.

Navy plans $31.7M JBCS (Joint Beam Control System) development awards as soon as Q4 2026 plus ~$30M containerized-hardware procurement by March 2027, per the Navy FY2027 budget request; JLWS R&D roadmap extends through FY2031; the 2028 demo is 'the early stages of a fielding process' (Military Times, opened, citing the budget request — trade press, not the budget book itself; D10-DIS-03).
disagreement_register.adjudication: Both sides' facts verify; the dispute is inference. OLD's claim that decisions concentrate in 2026-2028 is TRUE (awards 2026-07-09; JBCS Q4-2026), but its absolute kill is overstated: the funded roadmap runs through FY2031 with production options, so subsystem demand persists past 2030. NEW's revival is directionally supported, but its rank-4 merchant-socket premise is weakened by the opened primary evidence that JLWS awardee nLIGHT holds coherent beam combining as proprietary vertically-integrated technology — exactly the internalization risk OLD and BLIND both flagged. BLIND's mid-rank 14 (select, with prime-internalization as principal risk and geographic-portability heavily discounted) is the best-calibrated of the three dispositions on current evidence. Confidence: HIGH on facts; MODERATE on the adjudication that 'select mid-rank' is the correct disposition.

disagreement_register.subject: P3R2-C-09 standardized solid-state pulsed-power platform: OLD double-killed (P4 G7 64.4; P5 revival re-kill 52.2); NEW selected rank 12 + deep dive; BLIND rank 4 (top-set membership flips in all three directions).
findings: EtO regulatory direction: EPA's 2026-03-13 news release (opened, C09-DIS-02) proposes rescinding the risk-based standards of the 2024 EtO NESHAP, removing CEMS requirements and granting flexibility; a July 2025 Presidential proclamation had already exempted 22 facilities for 2 years (search corroboration). This CONFIRMS old06's 'EtO pressure moving in the wrong direction' premise and new06's D-08 kill rationale ('EtO NESHAP repeal proposed').

ScandiNova integration posture: ScandiNova's own news (opened, C09-DIS-01) documents the Microwave Amps acquisition with CEO quote 'this acquisition perfectly aligns with our strategy of enhancing our position in integrated power systems' — plus search-level 2025 turnkey RF unit with integrated Libera LLRF. Direction ('more proprietary integration') SUPPORTED by manufacturer primary (the specific acquisition is 2023-06-02, so 'moving toward' is a multi-year trend, not a 2026 event).

Cargo-scanning procurement: OSI Systems/Rapiscan release of 2026-05-14 (opened, C09-DIS-03) — ~$15M U.S. government task order for cargo and vehicle inspection systems with follow-on service; additional 2025-2026 orders ($10M, $19M, $50M) visible at search level (C09-DIS-04 not opened, timeout). Confirms live, dated cargo-NII procurement.
disagreement_register.adjudication: The verified record splits the difference. OLD's EtO-direction premise was RIGHT (now confirmed by EPA's own proposal), so BLIND's rank 4 — which leans on the record's EtO-replacement backlog leg — is too high on current facts; blindness to 2025-2026 regulatory reversal is the cause. But OLD's total kill was too absolute: the non-EtO demand legs (cargo NII, isotope/accelerator) are real and dated, and the incumbent's integrated-systems strategy leaves the interoperable-module position open, which is what NEW's rank-12 revival actually claims. NEW's mid-pack selection is the best-supported disposition. Confidence: HIGH on all three verified facts; MODERATE-TO-HIGH on the adjudication (select, mid-rank, non-EtO-led).

disagreement_register.subject: P3R2-C-07 low-ripple AFE rectification retrofits: BLIND top-10 (rank 10) vs OLD P4 G7 kill (60.0) vs NEW gates-clean-but-cut (61.6, first excluded). The only BLIND top-10 member rejected by BOTH baselines — the disagreement most likely to expose a BLIND error.
findings: US hydrogen window: 26 USC 45V(c)(3)(A) as amended now requires qualified clean-hydrogen facilities to begin construction before January 1, 2028 (previously January 1, 2033), amended by Public Law 119-21 section 70511, enacted 2025-07-04 (uscode.house.gov, opened, C07-DIS-01). This is exactly old06's 'window pulled forward to a 2027 construction-start deadline'.

Incumbent AFE occupancy: Ingeteam's own press item (opened, C07-DIS-02) shows the INGECON H2 FSK E12000 IGBT electrolyser rectifier with harmonic distortion 'less than 3%' (no extra filters/STATCOM needed), 12,000-15,860 Adc, commercial deliveries from September 2023; search-level: >600 MW rectifiers deployed, 36 kA containerized 'Megalyzer' (C07-DIS-03, not opened). The low-ripple transistor-rectification category C-07 targets is already merchant-served by an incumbent.
disagreement_register.adjudication: Old06's two load-bearing kill facts verify on primary sources. The hydrogen leg of a 2030-launch retrofit thesis is structurally impaired (new-build credit-eligible plants must be under construction by end-2027), and the 'AFE technology category' is occupied by shipping incumbent product — which A10's own record acknowledged (edge score 3, Sungrow-parity kill trigger) but underweighted. BLIND's electrowinning-first hedge partially anticipates this, but top-10 membership is not supported by current facts; both baselines' rejection (kill or cut) is better calibrated. This is the clearest identified BLIND ranking error, attributable to the web-free protocol operating on record-vintage facts. Confidence: HIGH.
